rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese equivalent for something relating to the tropics, as in 熱帶氣候 or 熱帶地區.

example.english: This is a tropic region, so it’s hot all year round.
example.traditional: 呢度係熱帶地區，全年都咁熱。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 hai6 jit6 daai3 dei6 keoi1 cyun4 nin4 dou1 gam3 jit6
